def walk(group, prefix='', depth=0, maxdepth=3):
    if depth>maxdepth: return
    for k,v in group.groups():
        print(prefix + k + '/')
        walk(v, prefix + '  ', depth+1, maxdepth)
    for k,v in group.arrays():
        print(prefix + f'{k}: shape={v.shape} dtype={v.dtype}')
